text:
The statement is admissible as an excited utterance under FRE 803(2). The pedestrian was visibly shaken by a startling crash and spoke about it immediately, and the exception does not require the declarant to be identified. Personal knowledge can be inferred from the pedestrian having just watched the accident, so my earlier answer was wrong to call it inadmissible, and the team note repeats that error. A judge could still exclude it if the record does not show what the pedestrian actually saw.

CONFIDENCE: 70
